0022600025.text: The Atlanta Hawks host the Washington Wizards in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, with the Hawks at 4-4 and in second place in the Southeast, half a game back, and the Wizards at 4-3 and first in the Southeast. Atlanta is 1-2 at home and enters on a one-game win streak, while Washington is 2-2 on the road and riding a two-game win streak. The Hawks are missing Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and the Wizards are without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Hawks won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 126-96 win in Atlanta on February 26, 2026.
